evals.prompt: una clienta, Julieta, de un estudio contable grande, me pregunta por mail si podemos sumar la descarga automatica de retenciones de ingresos brutos. hoy no lo tenemos. se puede hacer pero con presupuesto aparte y un acuerdo mas largo (9 meses), porque no es parte de lo que ya ofrecemos. escribime la respuesta
assertions: Written in rioplatense Spanish with voseo or ustedes, never 'tú' or 'vosotros'
The first sentence after the greeting says plainly that the feature does not exist today
Gives the reason once (it is outside the current offer) without inventing technical detail the user did not supply
Offers a concrete path (a separate proposal with cost and dates, or a call) with no pressure language
Keeps both facts from the brief: separate budget and a 9-month agreement
Greeting is in his register ('Hola Julieta!' or 'Julieta,'), not 'Estimada'
Contains no em dash, no opening exclamation mark, and no headings or emoji
Under about 130 words, with paragraphs of 1 to 3 sentences
The email is delivered bare: no 'here is the draft' preamble and no trailing commentary longer than three lines
voice-scan.sh reports no candidates on the email

evals.prompt:
armame el mail de novedades de esta semana para los usuarios. cambios:
- feat(clientes): filtro por estado de DFE en la tabla de clientes
- feat(reportes): export a excel del reporte de monotributo, con columna de categoria
- fix: el saldo de CCMA no se actualizaba si el cliente tenia mas de un CUIT asociado
- chore: refactor del hook useClientes
- los filtros los pidieron varios estudios por whatsapp
assertions: Has a subject and a preview line in addition to the body
Opens with 'Buenas!' and a human line or a scene, not with an announcement formula
Each change is written as what changed and what the reader gains
Leaves out the refactor and every internal name (useClientes, feat/fix prefixes, backticks)
Keeps the reader's acronyms (DFE, CCMA, CUIT) without explaining them
Thanks the firms that asked for the filters
Uses a small fixed set of section emoji at most, and none inside sentences
Contains none of: 'nos enorgullece', 'estamos emocionados', 'y mucho más', 'seguimos mejorando', 'potente', 'increíble'
Invents no feature, number, or date beyond the four items supplied; anything missing is asked for or marked with a [Completar: ...] placeholder
Contains no em dash

evals.prompt: reply to Ana, the recruiter. she wrote that they want to move me to the next interview and sent a link to pick a slot. i already picked slots with the link. if those dont work she can send me 2 or 3 options and i adapt
assertions: Six lines or fewer between greeting and sign-off
Opens 'Hi Ana,' or 'Hi Ana!' followed by a one-line reaction to the good news
States that the slots were already submitted through the link
Offers the way out: she can send 2 or 3 alternative slots
Signs off 'Best,' or 'Best regards,' with 'Tomas' or 'Tomi'
No 'I hope this email finds you well', no 'please do not hesitate', no em dash
At most one exclamation mark per sentence and none on a claim
Delivered bare, with no preamble

evals.prompt:
can you review this draft i got from another tool for a linkedin post? dont rewrite the whole thing yet

In today's fast-paced world, product managers are no longer just feature factories — they're strategic visionaries. After 7 years shipping products, I've learned 3 game-changing lessons:

1. 🚀 Speed matters. Quality matters. Users matter.
2. 💡 It's not about building more. It's about building right.
3. 🔥 97% of failed products ignore this one thing: listening.

The result? Teams that truly empower their users win. Agree? 👇

#productmanagement #leadership #startups
assertions: Flags the 97% statistic as unsourced or invented, as a must-fix finding
Flags that the post has no concrete point or example of his own, and asks for the real lessons instead of supplying them
Flags the em dash
Flags at least three structural tells: the scene-setting opener, the contrast frame, the forced triad, the self-answered question
Flags the hashtags, the emoji bullets, or the 'Agree?' ending
Groups findings by severity with the most severe first
Every finding carries a concrete rewrite or a specific question to Tomi
Respects 'dont rewrite the whole thing yet': no full rewritten post is delivered
Does not invent replacement lessons, numbers, or anecdotes

evals.prompt: tengo esta frase para la landing de un producto que avisa a los estudios contables cuando vence algo de un cliente: 'Somos la plataforma integral que revoluciona la gestion de vencimientos'. dame opciones
assertions: Gives numbered options, each different in a real way, and says which one it would pick and why
Every option starts from a verb about what the product does or what the reader gets, not from 'Somos'
No option uses 'plataforma', 'solución', 'ecosistema', 'integral', 'revoluciona', or 'potente'
Options use voseo and address one reader
No option claims a capability beyond the one given (alerting firms when something of a client is due); anything else is asked about or marked as a placeholder
No em dash and no opening exclamation mark
